Why Siya Decor

Siliguri's Preferred Showroom for Quality & Elegance

Located conveniently on MNSarkar Road, Siliguri, Siya Decor has earned a reputation for combining traditional woodworking artistry with modern interior aesthetic requirements. With our own manufacturing unit, every piece is built to your needs.

Whether you are designing a brand new home, remodeling a single bedroom, or sourcing stylish office furniture, our team helps you choose and customize furniture that lasts generations.
